name: Mamblas (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle from the hoist to the middle of the fly, bearing three blue wavy stripes.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 28 January 2005 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 237 of 12 December 2005); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a red cloth with a white triangle bearing three blue wavy stripes, its vertices at the ends of the staff and at the midpoint of the fly.
